name: NESTFUL
description: NESTFUL is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on nested sequences of API calls, where outputs of one call serve as inputs to subsequent calls. It contains over 1800 executable nested sequences to test the complexity of function calling in autonomous agents.
reputation: A specialized function-calling benchmark that is gaining attention for testing nested tool-use and agentic API sequencing, but is still relatively new.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license; highlights large scope for improvement in nested sequencing function calling.
